doctrine: Deterministic coherence audit of estate white-label findings. Disagreements are REPORTED with their cause, never silently reconciled. Measurement, not certification.
explanation: exposure-register uses (1-accuracy)*harm with harm=1.0 fallback when a mean_harm is missing -> inflates swarm/jail (no measured harm) to top; risk-register ranks only axes WITH measured harm -> ranks by real harm. Both are honest; the difference is a reporting choice, not a contradiction.
